inlines.v: NON-COMPLYING, adjective Neglecting or refusing to comply. Non compos mentis, or non compose, [Latin] not of sound mind; not having the regular use of reason; as a noun, an idiot; a lunatic; one devoid of reason, either by nature or by accident.
